_doc: THE single source of truth for credit-pack pricing (T10210). Consumed by app/pricing.py (billing + storage-cost anchor), src/frontend/src/config/pricing.js (app + landing site via the @editor alias). Packs must be listed in ascending price order with a strictly decreasing per-credit rate (the value ladder); tests enforce both. Stripe prices are created inline from price_cents, so a reprice here needs no Stripe dashboard work. Grants read pack metadata off the Stripe session/PI, not this file, so in-flight payments and historical rows are unaffected by a reprice.
